baseline: Unchanged original D5 N500 shared data and exact original-prior unknown/oracle results

jitter.construction: y_jitter=y_base+c*(individual_truth-base_truth); same original intercepts, errors, designs and masks
jitter.target: unweighted participant-average curve over all 500 defined individual curves

oracle: Known individual phase assignments with five common effects; full-covariance G Ainv G' intervals; no free individual effect levels

numerical.ambiguous_coverage: Full CDF at truth when within location tolerance of endpoint or active truth bounds straddle a threshold; unresolved floating ties block completion

distance: Absolute bin distance to nominal cuts; near <=2 contains 20 positions and far contains 44. For jitter these are nominal transition centers, not the population micro-boundaries.
RMSE: sqrt(mean replication-by-position squared error); delta-method MCSE and paired contrast influence differences, not independent-bin inference
paired_contrasts: jitter-baseline for working and oracle using their own truths
interpretation: Separate interventions, not an additive causal attribution. Shared-boundary violation cannot explain original shared-truth D5 undercoverage. Jitter oracle supplies individual timing information and a richer population mean representation. Report all conditions without outcome-based selection.
freeze: Bind this protocol, all software/input versions and original/baseline hashes before solving any new dataset. Pilot and formal identities are distinct; no incomplete or unresolved replication can enter the 500-case aggregate.
